limitations: Only the equal-buffer, no-epsilon, bias-uncorrected EMA mirror-style specialization on a deterministic scalar positive quadratic. The critical equality is nonhyperbolic and not classified. No independence or priority guarantee.
scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of the exact symmetric two-cycle and strict local Floquet stability frontier; symbolic and numerical finite checks are supplementary. Other cycles and global basins are not classified.
title: A sharp \(4-\sqrt{15}\) momentum frontier for two-cycles in EMA FlexGrad
